shared_elements: row of repeated vertical elements along a horizontal line
justification: The only real correspondence is formal and generic: both surfaces present a horizontal composition with a repeated series of upright elements along a base line (naturalistic robed processional figures in A, schematic crew strokes on a boat's hull in B), plus a small quadruped in profile in B and animal fragments at A's edge. A shows a naturalistic, fully modelled procession of human figures with vessels, hands touching, and a rosette border, while B shows a flat, linear silhouette boat with spiral prow and stick-like marks — utterly different subject matter and drawing conventions.
